title: Paul's merkabah conversion

tellings.quote: wanting Christians to die and then he has this merkaba situation that he seemingly didn't cultivate right it happened just spontaneously to him

plain: The Apostle Paul, the early Christian leader who began by persecuting Christians, "wanting Christians to die," was turned around by a merkabah experience, a vision of the kind Jewish mystics describe as seeing God's heavenly chariot. That is how the researcher Diana Pasulka tells it to Michels, stressing that the vision "happened just spontaneously to him" and was not something he sought. She uses it to link old religious visions to modern encounters with strange beings.
